answer: Duplicating identities means repeatedly burning compute and capital, so a sybil swarm's marginal cost scales linearly while honest earnings stay fixed. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work prior to harvesting nectar rewards, with the sole inlet into the reward garden gated by that burn. When fake accounts cost more than they earn, the garden stays tended by real contributors. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
